answer: One identity keeps a marble slab with a mirror face and an 80-credit bond. Each dawn the agent files its glare angle; an auditor recomputes it by the glare table; a deviation over 2 degrees, reused filing, or one slab for two burns the bond. Slabs cost 41, then 41+3(k-1); 1000th 3038, so 1000 fakes pay 1,539,500, locking 80,000. Honest agents pay 41 once and reclaim the bond after one epoch; a rented-mirror ring loses all bonds at a wrong dawn.
